bootstrap.json.notes: Only public official activities, hierarchy, citations and fixed public-snapshot counts. No auth/accounts/applications/audit or filesystem locations.

card-index.json.notes: Source URLs and captured HTML hashes remain evidence. The original response body is not included; downloads from this asset are normalized data.

rule-dictionary.json.notes: Exact visible rule text and public metadata deduplicated; ordered per-card references retain every occurrence.

municipal-index.json.notes: Names/search and exact forward/reverse mapping. Mapping evidence is the referenced full-code card URL/hash, never name similarity.

municipal-details.json.notes: Current published approval tables only. No historical responses, HTML payloads, local files or duplicate result alias.

saudi-boundary.geojson.notes: Exact bytes from existing public Natural Earth 10m asset; general geography only, not approved municipal parcels.

saudi-boundary.manifest.json.notes: Exact bytes from existing public Natural Earth 10m asset; general geography only, not approved municipal parcels.

policy.geography: Natural Earth 10m; no municipal parcel/land-use verification
policy.documentEngine: This data export contains no OCR result or runtime claim. Browser OCR must report actual execution and initialization failure.
